snippet.title: In that case... | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Coming out October 30th on Steam

https://store.steampowered.com/app/5075540/In_that_case/

Open loot cases, pray for rare drops, and pay off a massive debt before a descending ceiling of spikes crushes you. A first-person gambling roguelike about luck, greed, and survival.
